REPORT DATE: 07-08-2023 REPORT TIME: 0615 UTC REGION: ATLANTIC SUB REGION: SOUTHEAST U.S. AREA/BLOCK: SOUTH ATLANTIC 6728 IMAGE DATE: 07-07-2023 IMAGE TIME: 2313 UTC DATA SOURCE: SENTINEL1A MODE: INTERFEROMETRIC WIDE (IW) VV RESOLUTION: 5X20 METER LOCATION: 31°18"15" N/78°37"25" W AREA: 3.65 SQUARE KILOMETERS CONFIDENCE: MEDIUM REPORT MAP/GIS FILES: HTTPS://WWW.OSPO.NOAA.GOV/PRODUCTS/OCEAN/MARINEPOLLUTION/ REMARKS: POSSIBLE OIL WAS OBSERVED IN SATELLITE IMAGERY. THIS ANOMALY IS UNCONFIRMED AS OIL. THE POSSIBLE OIL APPEARED TO BE THE RESULT OF A BILGE DUMP FROM A VESSEL LOCATED APPROXIMATELY 155 NMI SE OF SAVANNAH, GA. THE POSSIBLE OIL WAS IN MULTIPLE SEGMENTS BEGINNING 13.4 NMI SSE FROM THE SUSPECTED SOURCE, AND WAS APPROXIMATELY 3.6 NMI IN AGGREGATE LENGTH, AND UP TO 0.6 NMI IN WIDTH. EACH SEGMENT WAS DARK AGAINST ITS BACKGROUND WITH SHARP EDGES AND SHARP CORNERS, AND APPEARED TO START AND STOP ABRUPTLY. WINDS AT THE TIME OF THE IMAGE WERE FROM THE SW AT AROUND 15 KTS. UNCERTAINTIES: THE POSSIBLE OIL WAS NOT CONNECTED TO THE SUSPECTED SOURCE, ALTHOUGH ALL SEGMENTS AND THE VESSEL WERE IN LINE WITH EACH OTHER. THERE WAS NO APPRECIABLE WIDENING WITH DISTANCE. THESE FACTORS LIMITED CONFIDENCE TO MEDIUM THAT THIS WAS OIL. IF YOU WOULD LIKE TO SHARE ANY FEEDBACK ABOUT THIS REPORT OR HAVE QUESTIONS, PLEASE CONTACT THE OPERATIONAL ANALYST AT (301) 683-1403 OR SEND TO OCEANMAP@NOAA.GOV. THE POSSIBLE OIL WAS IN MULTIPLE SEGMENTS BEGINNING 13.4 NMI SSE FROM THE SUSPECTED SOURCE, AND WAS APPROXIMATELY 3.6 NMI IN AGGREGATE LENGTH, AND UP TO 0.6 NMI IN WIDTH. EACH SEGMENT WAS DARK AGAINST ITS BACKGROUND WITH SHARP EDGES AND SHARP CORNERS, AND APPEARED TO START AND STOP ABRUPTLY. WINDS AT THE TIME OF THE IMAGE WERE FROM THE SW AT AROUND 15 KTS. UNCERTAINTIES: THE POSSIBLE OIL WAS NOT CONNECTED TO THE SUSPECTED SOURCE, ALTHOUGH ALL SEGMENTS AND THE VESSEL WERE IN LINE WITH EACH OTHER. THERE WAS NO APPRECIABLE WIDENING WITH DISTANCE. THESE FACTORS LIMITED CONFIDENCE TO MEDIUM THAT THIS WAS OIL.
